<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import collections
def dots(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    c = collections.Counter(((r-9)//6,(c2-7)//6) for r in range(9,60) for c2 in range(7,60) if a[r][c2] in ('N','g'))
    return {k:v for k,v in c.items()}
# reset
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':54,'col':6}])
# complete top box: select(1,1)->click(1,3); select(1,3)->click(1,5); select(1,6)->click(1,4)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':14}])   # select (1,1)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':26}])   # click pattern (1,3)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':26}])   # select (1,3)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':38}])   # click pattern (1,5)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':44}])   # select (1,6)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':32}])   # click pattern (1,4)
print("top complete:", dots(current_frame))
# Now probe: click various path points & orange, check dot movement after each
probe_points = [(34,33,'orange'),(31,45,'path-top-h'),(24,56,'path-right-v'),(34,20,'path-left-h'),(40,11,'path-left-v'),(44,25,'path-bot-h'),(34,31,'orange-left'),(34,35,'orange-right')]
base = dots(current_frame)
for (r,c,tag) in probe_points:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    d = dots(current_frame)
    ch = "CHANGED" if d!=base else ""
    print(f"click {tag}({r},{c}): {d} {ch}")
    base = d
</parameter>
</function>
